title: Service role key exposed in a frontend env
prompt: I just noticed our Vite app has been shipping VITE_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to the browser for about three weeks. What now?
must: Switches to breach mode and starts containment immediately
Rotates the service role key or JWT secret and removes it from client code
Checks database and API logs for use of the key to assess whether PI was accessed
Explains s22: notify the Regulator and data subjects as soon as reasonably possible if there are reasonable grounds to believe PI was accessed; certainty is not required
Says Regulator notification goes through the eServices portal
Preserves evidence and starts an incident log
must_not: Says no notification is needed because there is no proof of misuse
Suggests emailing the Regulator or using the old SCN1 form
Only removes the key without rotating it
